quotes.title: Gliese 486
quotes.card: Gliese 486, also known as Wolf 437 and formally named Gar, is a red dwarf star 26.4 light-years away in the constellation Virgo.
quotes.introduction: It hosts one known exoplanet, Gliese 486 b.
